title: Quark structure and octonions
note: The source of the decomposition the colour-algebra section depends on: fixing one imaginary unit reduces $\mathrm{Aut}(\mathbb{O}) = G_2$ to the stabilizer $\mathrm{SU}(3)$, under which $\mathrm{Im}(\mathbb{O})$ splits as $\mathbb{R}\oplus\mathbb{C}^3$ with the quark triplet and antitriplet as complex-conjugate (NOT self-dual) summands.
